extracted.name: Creamy Cucumber Tomato Salad
extracted.description: This creamy cucumber and tomato salad is tossed with a tangy sour cream, balsamic vinaigrette, and dill dressing. It's light, crisp, and refreshing!
ingredient_lines: 0.25 cup sour cream, or to taste
2.5 teaspoons balsamic vinaigrette dressing (such as Wish-Bone®)
4 pinches garlic salt with parsley (such as Lawry's®)
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Place tomatoes and cucumber into a bowl. Add sour cream, balsamic vinaigrette, lemon juice, dill, and garlic salt; stir to combine. Season with salt and pepper.
